`line-height` is inherited. When a parent declares `line-height: 2` (unitless), children inherit the unitless number rather than a pre-computed length, and each child computes its own line-height as `number × own font-size`.

For `root>big`: font-size is 32px, inherited line-height is 2, so computed line-height = 2 × 32px = 64px. This is confirmed by the rendered data: its bounding rect is height 64 and computed line-height is 64px.

ANSWER: 64
